API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPolicy ManagementUpdates the rule order for the specified ID.
Updates the rule order for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/policySet/:policySetId/rule/:ruleId/reorder/:newOrder

Updates the rule order for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

policySetId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the policy set.

ruleId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of a rule in a policy.

newOrder
int32
REQUIRED

The new order of the rule.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64
Default value: 0

​
